echoParts: Truly, truly, I say to you
he cannot see the kingdom of God
verseText: Jesus answered him, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born again he cannot see the kingdom of God.'
meaning: Our spirits (or souls) are born dead in sin. In order to believe and join God's kingdom, we need God's Spirit to bring our spirits to life.
